title: Werwulf
overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

title: Violette
overview: Violette Toussaint, a cemetery caretaker in a small town in Burgundy, is a unique observer and a compassionate listener. Her peaceful life is filled by conversations with quirky cemetery workers and the many visitors who share their stories of love, loss, and life. However, her routine is disrupted when a local police chief arrives at her door with an unusual request. As they grow closer, Violette comes to understand that the truth behind long-buried mysteries in her past must be uncovered if she wants to take another chance on life and, against all odds, love.

title: Club Kid
overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

title: Ink
overview: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb band together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

title: The Class Trip
overview: The film follows a junior high school class on a field trip to Auschwitz in Poland. While the adults intend for the students to experience the gravity of history and a profound tragedy firsthand, the teenagers largely view the trip as an opportunity to break away from their parents, drink alcohol, and find romantic partners. These expectations are on a direct collision course with reality.

title: Witch on the Holy Night
overview: Aoko Aozaki, an ordinary high school girl, is actually a Magician who lives in the modern world...though she is still only an apprentice. As she spends her days living alongside her housemate, Alice Kuonji, striving to become a full-fledged Magician...she meets a boy, beginning of one young girl's story — the tale of a Witch.

title: Bygd på kjærlighet
overview: "Bygd på kjærlighet" is based on the real events that led to the birth of Pizza Grandiosa. The film takes us back to the 80s, where a group of Westerners refuse to comply, and instead decide to stand together and take up the fight against the superior power in Oslo. With love, rage, creative inventions and a good dose of madness, they lay the foundation for what turned out to be one of Norway's most famous brands.  "Bygd på kjærlighet" is a humorous and heartwarming story about a group of people who can argue about most things, but stand together when it really matters.
